product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Classic Ceiling Pendant Chandelier Fixture With White Drum Shade- 20 x 20 x 42 Inches, Black
product.description: A modern spin on the classic chandelier, this light fixture has four arms covered by one rectangular shade. The metal hardware combines with a white fabric shade to blend with your existing styles.
